_comment: Advisories accepted with a stated reason and an expiry date.
An exception with no expiry becomes permanent by accident, so every entry
must carry one — scripts/check-audit.mjs fails the build when an exception
lapses, which forces the decision to be made again rather than inherited.
Only moderate and below may be excepted. A high or critical finding fails
the build regardless of what is written here.

exceptions.reason: Missing buffer bounds check in uuid v3/v5/v6 when a `buf` argument is passed. Reached only through exceljs, which calls uuidv4() with no arguments (lib/xlsx/xform/sheet/cf-ext/cf-rule-ext-xform.js), so the vulnerable path is unreachable from this codebase. npm's suggested fix is a DOWNGRADE of exceljs from 4.4.0 to 3.4.0, which would trade an unreachable advisory for six years of unpatched spreadsheet parsing.

Carrier of the uuid advisory above; no fixed release exists on the 4.x line. Used only to BUILD workbooks from our own data in export/excelBuilder.js — this application never parses an untrusted .xlsx, except in the trainer bulk import, which is admin-only and size-capped at 6mb.
